scope: ONE exploratory exact probe of the sampled quaternary Hadamard-product family q_ij=(alpha_i∘beta_j)/sqrt10 (alpha rows of Paley conference H=I+iC over GF(9); beta_j(t)=alpha_j(pi(t)), pi from a fixed-seed sample). conditions: Freeze code, seed, sample size and self-budget 290 s by SHA256 in a lane record BEFORE launch; send hashes when launching.
Exactly one stdlib Python process, integer/Z4 arithmetic only (no floats in decisions); lane TMPDIR; outputs < 1 MiB, exclusive-create.
Fresh statvfs admission >= 12.2e9 B immediately before launch; in-run floor guard 12e9 B; any guard/SIGTERM stop => UNKNOWN, no retry without new GO.
No subprocess/tool timeouts, no SIGKILL, no ulimit; self-budget enforced inside the program only.
Must finish before 15:30 PDT; no second probe, sample extension or family change under this GO.
Any hit: immediately freeze outputs, run only the frozen exact_rqls_checker_v1, report; parent arranges independent verification.
